content: This flowchart provides a detailed strategy for reducing cardiovascular risk in patients aged 18 years or older who have type 2 diabetes (T2D) and at least one of the following conditions: atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD), heart failure (HF), diabetic kidney disease (DKD), or are at high risk for ASCVD. The approach involves the use of SGLT2 inhibitors or GLP-1 receptor agonists as part of a targeted therapeutic plan. The process begins by addressing multiple aspects of the patient’s health simultaneously to optimize outcomes.
